_comment: The rideable class. Any species listed here can be mounted like a horse:
action-click it (or face it and press the action button) while it is your
summoned active companion, on foot, outdoors.
Per-species SeatLiftPixels raises that rider, in world pixels; larger sits
higher. Optional SeatShiftXPixels overrides the sideways nudge for one species.
SpeedBonus is the land-speed adjustment. Swimming mounts set CanTraverseWater
and use their separately authored WaterSpeedBonus on oceans, ponds, and rivers.
Flight-only mounts set CanFlyOverWater and keep SpeedBonus above any water.
A mount with both flags, such as Lugia, uses its authored swimming speed.
MountScaleMultiplier changes only the mounted Pokemon render. The ordinary
companion keeps its species scale. RiderInFrontWhenFacingDown overrides
Stardew's usual south-facing mount-over-rider layer order.
MountSoundStyle controls land movement: Hooves keeps native horse steps;
Paws, Claws, Heavy, Wings, and Hover use Pokemon-specific terrain or air cues.
CanTraverseWater mounts use waterSlosh only while over open water; flyers do not splash.
RiderOffsets move the farmer in screen/world pixels for each standing facing.
Optional MovingRiderOffsets tune the moving rider separately; omitted entries
inherit that species' RiderOffsets, keeping existing mounts unchanged.
Each species now carries its tuned standing offsets for every facing direction.
Seat lifts are generated by tools/mount_preview, which finds each mount's back
in its own sprite. Rider offsets are authored with run_mount_tuner.py.
The two Default* values below tune EVERY rider: DefaultSeatSinkPixels lowers
derived seats (larger = lower) when the preview tool is rerun with --apply;
DefaultSeatShiftXPixels moves every live mount and preview sideways immediately.
Editing this file only needs a game restart, not a rebuild.
